heading: cyUpload files (optional)
paragraphs: cyYou can upload any files that you believe are relevant to your claim or that a judge should be aware of.
beforeUploadText: cyGive each file a name that explains what it is. For example, 'Receipt of payment from Jane Smith'
uploadHint: cyYou can upload a PDF, Word (DOCX) or Excel (XLSX) file. Each file must be smaller than 20MB.
